preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 25 contains the Levirate-marriage law (vv. 5–10), the weights-and-measures command, and the Amalek-extermination memorial. 4QDeutᵍ preserves vv. 13–18. 4QDeutⁱ covers vv. 1–26:5. Coverage is moderate.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The Levirate law that frames Ruth 4 and Mark 12:19 / Matt 22:24 / Luke 20:28 is preserved verbatim.
preamble.scroll_condition: Moderate coverage; vv. 13-18 well preserved by 4QDeutᵍ.

variant_notes: The Levirate-marriage law tracks MT. Cited in the Sadducean-resurrection question (Mark 12:19 / Matt 22:24 / Luke 20:28).
The 'remember what Amalek did' command tracks MT. The blotting-out-Amalek motif echoes at 1 Sam 15.
